text:
liam: Heads-up — after merge 4221 we're seeing ~30% p50 increase on int4 small-model serving in canary. Repro on canary cluster A.

sasha: that's huge. Any profile yet? Is it kernel selection or batching?

chen: grabbing a perf profile now. quick snippet from perf top:
```
hotspots:
  dequant_path (+45% CPU)
  kv_cache_lookup (+22%)
  batch_coalesce_loop (+18%)
```
link: http://perf.internal/fg/1799001111 (flamegraph)

maya: CI perf job rtb-int4 failed earlier: https://ci.internal/jobs/rtb-int4/987 — p50 up 28% vs baseline

ci-bot: rtb-int4 perf regression detected: p50 +27.9% — threshold exceeded. Started bisect.

maya: I ran a quick bisect — top suspect is PR #4218 (heuristic: batch merge threshold change). Reverting that locally fixes p50.

liam: do we know why batch threshold would cause extra dequant work? expected fewer small batches.

chen: PR4218 changed merge size to prefer merging across kv boundaries which increases kvcache lookups and forces more dequant on-path. The code path now does an extra `dequant()` per shard when merge_flag=true.

axel: here is the diff I found: 
```
- if (can_merge && within_shard) out.merge();
+ if (can_merge || across_shard) out.merge();
```
That across_shard cheaper heuristic ignored kv cache locality.

sasha: agreed. quick fix: revert PR or patch heuristics to keep shard-local merges only for int4. Any tests to catch this earlier?

maya: adding microbench in CI for kv-locality + int4 dequant overhead. Also rolling canary back for cluster A.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for cluster A (merge 4221 reverted) :arrow_down: — ETA 3m

liam: excellent. follow-up items:
- add perf unit that simulates cross-shard merges
- add metric for dequant calls per request
- consider adding heuristic weight for kvcache locality

axel: I'll open PR with the patch that gates across_shard merge for quantized profiles. short test included.

chen: after revert on canary p50 back to baseline. marking as resolved on canary but leaving open for full rollout hold.

sasha: thanks everyone. Add a note in the release notes that batch heuristic changed behavior for low-precision.

liam: 👍 keep the bisect artifacts in the ticket: TICKET-998

ci-bot: bisect finished: culprit PR 4218 — recommended action: revert or patch. 

maya: will pair with axel to get a patch tonight and re-run staging canary.

deploy-bot: Staging canary created for patched branch — monitoring.

liam: closing thread once patch in production. Great catch.
